newsitem.title: USA: Hutchinson files for 3.4 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Hutchinson files for 3.4 mln common shares.

text.p: Hutchinson Technology Inc filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission Wednesday to sell up to 3,375,000 common shares.

Of the total, three million common will be offered for sale by the company and 375,000 common will be offered by certain selling shareholders. After the offering, the outstanding shares will total 19,374,495 common.

The company has granted the underwriters an over-allotment option to buy up to 506,250 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Montgomery Securities, Hambrecht & Quist and Dain Bosworth Inc.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, primarily manufacturing and support equipment and construction of a new phototech facility, the company said.
Hutchinston Technology, based in Hutchinson, Minn., is a supplier of suspension assemblies for hard disk drives.
